modules.name: Expert mode
modules.note: Expert villain stages + Expert encounter set.

steps.text: Each player picks an identity card, alter-ego side up
steps.note: First game: Spider-Man and Captain Marvel vs Rhino

steps.text: Set your hit point dial to the starting hit points on your identity card
Choose a first player; give them the first player token
Set aside each hero's obligation card
Set aside each hero's nemesis and nemesis encounter cards (not in play)
Each player shuffles their player deck by their identity card
Pool of damage, threat and all-purpose tokens; stunned, confused and tough status cards nearby
Villain deck in stage order ({stages}) and main scheme deck in the center
Villain hit point dial = the card's value x {n}
Resolve the main scheme's "Setup" instructions (read side A, flip to B)
Encounter deck: villain set + Standard set + the scenario's modular set + the set-aside obligations; shuffle
Add the Expert encounter set (Exhaustion, Masterplan, Under Fire)
Each player draws up to their hand size (bottom left of the identity card)
Mulligan: discard any cards and draw back up (don't reshuffle)
Nemesis cards stay out until an encounter card calls for them
Per-player icon values use the number of players who started
Player phase: the first player takes their turn, then each player in order
